{{Top}}
A '''biocomputer''', or '''biocomp''',<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> was a small [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that was installed in a [[Sentience/Legends|person]] to improve their reactions and awareness. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] had a [[Rhen-Orm/Legends|Rhen-Orm]] biocomputer implanted in her skull.
